title: Cerebras reports Q3 core revenue up 70% YoY to $230.9M, vs. $214.7M est., issues strong guidance, and announces a Microsoft deal; CBRS jumps 15%+ after hours (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: Cerebras reports Q3 core revenue up 70% YoY to $230.9M, vs. $214.7M est., issues strong guidance, and announces a Microsoft deal; CBRS jumps 15%+ after hours — Cerebras Systems reported better-than-expected revenue and quarterly guidance in its earnings report on Thursday, and touted a new deal with Microsoft.
